original_frontmatter.name: audio-design
original_frontmatter.description: Engine-neutral game audio technique: bus layout, volume sliders in decibels, loudness, ducking music under dialogue, adaptive music and SFX variation, with Godot, Unity and FMOD/Wwise mappings. Use when mixing a game, making music react to combat, fixing repetitive footsteps or beat sync, or a mix that clips or pumps. Not for the Godot audio API (`godot-audio`).
